---
title: "easydta: test-comparison DTA meta-analysis (anti-CCP1 vs CCP2)"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
if (!requireNamespace("easydta", quietly = TRUE)) {
  remotes::install_github("vanioljantunes/easydta")
}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, grid, gridExtra, easydta)
```

```{r load_data}
# Cochrane Handbook chapter 10 / Appendix 14 anti-CCP dataset
# (Nishimura et al.).  Two test generations (CCP1, CCP2) compared as a
# between-study covariate -- this matches Cochrane Figure 10.4.a.
path <- system.file("extdata/anti_ccp.csv", package = "easydta")
d <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(d)
```

```{r analyse}
# One call for the covariate / unpaired comparison: reshape + LR fit +
# comparison + per-arm single fits, keyed by the `generation` column.
res <- dta_compare_tests(d, test_var = "generation")
print(res)
```

```{r save_forest_CCP1}
png("forest_CCP1.png", width = 1400, height = 700, res = 150)
dta_forest(res, arm = "CCP1")
dev.off()
```

```{r save_forest_CCP2}
png("forest_CCP2.png", width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 150)
dta_forest(res, arm = "CCP2")
dev.off()
```

```{r save_funnel}
# Cochrane Handbook ch. 10.6.4 / Deeks, Macaskill & Irwig (2005):
# funnel plot of ln(DOR) against 1/sqrt(ESS) plus the weighted-regression
# Deeks test for funnel asymmetry (proxy for publication bias).  Per arm.
png("funnel_CCP1.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(
  dta_funnel(res, arm = "CCP1",
             test = "anti-CCP1",
             outcome    = "rheumatoid arthritis",
             population = "adults")
)
dev.off()

png("funnel_CCP2.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(
  dta_funnel(res, arm = "CCP2",
             test = "anti-CCP2",
             outcome    = "rheumatoid arthritis",
             population = "adults")
)
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc_pairwise}
# Per-arm SROC (separate panels, saved side by side -- matches the
# layout of Cochrane Handbook Figure 10.4.a).  `.e` is the intervention
# arm (CCP2) and `.c` is the control arm (CCP1).  Beneath the panels a
# Cochrane-style table reports per-arm Sens/Spec/AUC with 95% CIs, the
# absolute differences (.e - .c), and p-values:
#   * Sens/Spec p-values come from the LR tests (Cochrane Appendix 12,
#     Table A12.1 rows 2-3 in `res$compare$lr_tests`).
#   * AUC inference uses dmetatools::AUC_comparison() (Noma & Matsushima
#     2020) -- joint parametric bootstrap that returns each arm's AUC,
#     dAUC, their CIs, and the p-value for dAUC = 0.  Set
#     `auc_ic = FALSE` to skip the bootstrap (faster preview; AUC row is
#     omitted and the in-panel AUC summary loses its CI).
png("sroc_pairwise.png", width = 1800, height = 1000, res = 150)
g <- dta_sroc_pair(res,
                   arm.e  = "CCP2", test.e = "anti-CCP2",
                   arm.c  = "CCP1", test.c = "anti-CCP1",
                   outcome    = "rheumatoid arthritis",
                   population = "adults",
                   auc_ic     = TRUE,
                   B          = 2000)
grid::grid.draw(g)
dev.off()
```
